speak.title: Role-play: is a handmade plate worth the price?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You sell handmade plates with traditional patterns. Each plate costs 80 pounds. Explain why it costs so much and who makes it. You can lower the price a little, but only if the customer asks a good question.

b.text: You like a handmade plate with a traditional pattern, but it's very expensive. Ask who makes it and where the money goes. Decide if you will buy it, buy a cheaper one, or leave.

phrases: I'd love to buy it, but it's a bit expensive.
I can't lower the price much, but I'll add a free cup.
We're not rich, so could we meet in the middle?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the customer buy the plate, and was the price fair?
